**0.8.0 is a breaking release.** It changes the storage and protocol format to format epoch 4. A 0.8 node refuses epoch-3 Raft WAL directories and object-storage prefixes at startup, refuses 0.7 peers, snapshots and backups, and `ursulactl restore` refuses 0.7 backups. There is no migration, no in-place upgrade, no rolling upgrade and no rollback.

- **If you cannot move your data yet, stay on 0.7.6.**
- **Deploy 0.8 fresh** on empty PVCs and never-used object-storage prefixes, and move data by export and re-import. Ursula provides no converter.
- **Set the cluster id.** Every node of a multi-node cluster needs `server.cluster_id`, and every chart install needs `server.clusterId`. Every `HEAD` answer carries it as `Ursula-Cluster-Id`, with `Ursula-Protocol: 2`, and peers of another cluster are refused.
- **Write keys, typed answers and one outcome rule.** `x-ursula-not-applied` is removed. A repeat of a producer write gets a typed answer, so a client resolves an unknown outcome by sending the same write again, and `Producer-Digest` makes the body part of a write's identity. A refusal's status and error code say whether its request applied nothing, a leadership loss after a proposal answers `503` with `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, and `ursula_headers::classify` implements the rule for every client (`WriteKind` is `#[non_exhaustive]`). A proxy in front of Ursula must not answer a forwarded write with its own `4xx` other than `408`, or with its own redirect, must not resend a forwarded write unless the answer proves nothing applied, and must not accept a body above the server's request limit.
- **History identity.** `Stream-Incarnation` changes on a restore and on an accepted loss, not only on a delete and recreate. `HEAD` names what survived with `Stream-Previous-Incarnation` and `Stream-Inherited-Offset`. `accept-unsynced-loss` takes a recovery plan that counts every voter set the replicas report, so it recovers across a rolled-back membership change. A replica whose committed entries a plan dropped waits for an operator to rejoin its node as a wiped node. The backup import requires `x-ursula-backup-blake3`.
- **Every error answer has a JSON body** with a stable code, and every `413` names its limit in `Ursula-Max-Request-Bytes` or `Ursula-Max-Snapshot-Bytes`.
- **Request limits and snapshots.** Every request body is at most 32 MiB, and a gateway whose `--max-request-body-bytes` is higher refuses to start. A node with a cold backend needs `server.http_inflight_body_size` of at least 64 MiB. Larger snapshots, up to 1 GiB, go up in parts on a node with a cold backend, and snapshot reads honor a byte range.
- **The chart serves Raft on its own port** (`server.clusterListen`, `4439`). Choose the planes before the first install.
- **Writes are routed before their body**, and new immutable read resources let a cache in front store chunks and snapshots.
- **The gateway body budget of 0.7.6 is carried over.** Only its refusals' wire form follows the new error bodies.
- **The SQLite VFS is redesigned.** A commit is local and replicates in the background, `await db.synced()` is the output gate, outages are lag, and a history change keeps the cache or moves it into `salvage/`. The 0.8 extension refuses 0.7 streams and servers. Export each database with 0.7 using `VACUUM INTO` and import it with `importSqlite` or `ursula_import`.

Known issues: [#411](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/411), [#461](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/461), [#465](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/465), [#490](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/490), [#494](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/494), [#496](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/496), [#517](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/517), [#518](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/518), [#539](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/539) and [#561](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/561). Every change is listed in the [0.8.0 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#080), and installing 0.8.0 is described in [Upgrading to 0.8](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/operations#upgrading-to-08).
